window-1.title: net-art.org — Art projects
window-1.blurb: It's a whole archive of browser-made art by people who just wanted to build something odd and lovely, which is exactly the kind of rabbit hole you disappear into and come out of with three new side quests.

window-2.title: The radical reasons why you dream of making things by hand
window-2.blurb: This one makes the case that your hand-sewn costumes and ancestry archives aren't hobbies but a quiet rebellion — a whole essay arguing that the urge to master something with your hands is the most radical thing you can do.

window-3.title: Spicy Passion Fruit Mocktail (AKA "Mockarita")
window-3.blurb: Four ingredients, but you get to char a jalapeño over open flame for smoky depth — a tiny bit of theatre for a drink that's tart, tropical, and named like it's in on the joke.

window-4.title: Ignant — Interiors & Home Visits
window-4.blurb: It's a rolling feed of real people's homes — the kind stacked with books, odd ceramics and lamps with a story — and you'll want to rearrange your whole living room within ten minutes of scrolling.

window-5.title: Miura, Joo Chiat
window-5.blurb: You have to walk through a three-storey Joo Chiat shophouse full of independent labels before you find this tiny matcha-and-wagashi counter hiding at the back, which makes getting a daifuku feel like a small side quest you completed.
